Solara — (9.5) PULSAR

THE DRAGON AND THE SERPENT

"Dragon and Serpent"

Level 40. The Dragon (300 fighters) and The Serpent (140 wizards) are waiting. Full crew fight. Everyone gets a moment. They win and take both as prisoners.

[Verse 1]

Level forty

And they were waiting

The Dragon — three hundred fighters

Disciplined, armed, ready

The Serpent — one hundred and forty wizards

Already casting, already moving

Twelve versus four hundred and forty

The math did not favor twelve

[Pre-Chorus]

Solara looked at her crew

Her crew looked at the field

Herc cracked his knuckles

[Chorus]

Dragon and Serpent

Four hundred and forty

Dragon and Serpent

We go anyway

This crew has been to thirty-nine levels

This crew has fought a Leviathan

This crew has a cook with a fifty thousand bounty

Dragon and Serpent —

We go

[Verse 2]

Herc went first

(obviously)

(Herc always goes first)

(three hundred fighters, Herc, approximately four minutes)

Cassie took the left flank

Lara from above — wings wide, not gentle

Aldric in formation behind her — precise

Castor moving through the middle like starlight

Rion — distance, every shot counted

Persy — negotiating with anyone who paused

(nobody paused)

(Persy fought anyway)

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Cygnus danced through the wizards

(this sounds wrong)

(it was extremely effective)

Crotus — all four legs, all of them working

Draco and Hydra watched from the prisoner position

They were technically still prisoners

They watched very carefully

[Chorus]

Dragon and Serpent

Still standing, barely

Dragon and Serpent

The crew is standing

Twelve against four forty

Every crew member moved today

Every crew member contributed

Dragon and Serpent —

We won

[Bridge]

The Dragon stood

The Serpent stood

Both of them looked at twelve people

Who had just done that

Nobody spoke

[Final Chorus]

Dragon and Serpent

What do we do with you

Dragon and Serpent

They won’t talk

Solara looked at them

Looked at the gate to level forty-one

Looked back

“You’re coming with us”

[Outro]

The Dragon said nothing

The Serpent said nothing

The crew moved toward level forty-one

Plus two

[footsteps — fourteen now]
